description: Render a video template as an MP4 and return a link to it. Pass layer overrides in `modifications`. A long render answers the video id first: read the video with get_video until it is done. Each second of video counts as one generation, and two at 60 fps.

modifications.description: Layer overrides keyed by layer name. A string replaces the layer text, e.g. {"headline":"Summer sale"}. An object sets layer specific fields, e.g. {"photo":{"src":"https://example.com/a.png"}}, {"qr":{"qrcode":"https://example.com"}}, {"table":{"rows":[["A","B"]]}}, {"tag":{"visible":false}}.

templateId.description: The id of a video template, for example tpl_abc123

name: create_video
title: Create video
